name: SendPadDma
evidence: original assembly: sends a pad slot's DMA words to the IOP, printing its message when the transfer cannot start (SetPadActuatorBytes calls it)

name: InitPadLibrary
evidence: binds the two pad clients to the services 0x80000100 and 0x80000101, retrying until bound, and initialises the module (InitPadSystem calls it)

name: OpenPadPort
evidence: original assembly: opens a port's slot on a 64-byte aligned buffer of two frames, printing its messages on a bad buffer or a slot already open (InitPadRecord calls it)

name: GetNewerPadFrame
evidence: refreshes a slot's two frames from memory and returns the one with the higher count

name: ReadPadFrame
evidence: copies the newer frame of an open slot into data and returns its size (PollPadInput calls it)

name: GetPadSlotState
evidence: returns the state of an open slot's newer frame (5 for a stable slot with a request running), or 0x63 when closed (UpdatePadConnection polls it)

name: SetPadRequestMode
evidence: sets the request mode of an open slot's newer frame (2 while a request runs)

name: GetPadRequestMode
evidence: returns the request mode of an open slot's newer frame (UpdatePadConnection reads it)

name: SendPadTwoWordRequest
evidence: sends the pad module command 6 with two words for a slot and marks the request running on success (UpdatePadConnection calls it)

name: SetPadActuatorBytes
evidence: original assembly: stores the bytes for a slot's actuators and sends them (UpdatePadPattern and StopPadPatternOutput call it)

name: SendPadSixByteRequest
evidence: sends the pad module command 8 with six bytes for a slot and marks the request running on success (UpdatePadConnection calls it)

name: SendPadMaskRequest
evidence: sends the pad module command 10 with a mask for a slot and marks the request running on success

name: HasFullPadMask
evidence: tells whether an open slot's button mask (func_00204B80) is 0x3FFFF (UpdatePadConnection calls it)

name: SendFullPadMask
evidence: sends SendPadMaskRequest with the mask 0xFFF for an open slot (UpdatePadConnection calls it)

name: RefreshPadFrames
evidence: original assembly: invalidates the data cache over a slot's frames so they are read from memory (GetNewerPadFrame calls it)
